# OverCue Desktop 2.2.13 for Windows

- Prepare DJM-A9 stems EQ updates from the official 1.22 firmware file, with progress, cancellation, download links and mixer update instructions.
- Turning stems EQ off holds normal mixer EQ at neutral until each knob returns to 12 o’clock.
- The top channel meter light blinks while stems EQ is active.
- Find your equipment under separate Players and Mixers sections.
- Compact, centered update notices offer direct Update and Go to Firmware buttons, leaving more room for your USB library.
